Name: Nyapu Gremio's Captain Portraits
Author: spiriituals
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
I edited and color altered some portraits provided by Nyapu and Aelinore-- none of this is my art, only some small edits to give the appearance of the NPC included in the "The Gremio's Captain" mod by Rupnan!

^^Apologies if there's any misalignment as I did not test the portraits in my own game. Please let me now if you notice any pesky pixels where they should not be!

Credits to Nyapu and Aelinore for the assets! Credits to Rupnan for the NPC mod!

[b][u][size=5]UPDATE!![/size][/u][/b]
[i]- Updated the portraits to be more serious and match Kaelen's personality a bit more.[/i]
[i]- Updated to include a set of portraits that include the expressive hands (a personal preference).[/i]
[i]- The old files will remain in the misc section for anyone who likes. [/i]


[size=4][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size]
Unzip the download file "Gremio'sNPC(-, hands, or less serious)" and then drag the "[NPC] The Gremio’s Captain" folder into your already existing mods folder where you keep the main mod. When you are prompted to replace files of the same name-- do so.
OR you can find the "portraits" folder at --[i][NPC] The Gremio’s Captain\[CP] The Gremio's Captain\assets\images\portraits[/i]-- yourself and drag the replacers into it. Personally, I tend to do this just to ensure everything goes neatly where it is supposed to :P

[b]Requirements[/b]
These are REPLACERS! You need the "The Gremio's Captain" mod for these to work.
